style: A bright, bold, slightly stylised 3D illustration in the look of a clean low-poly video game: clear sunny daylight, simple smooth shapes, saturated but natural colours, a deep blue sky with a few white clouds. Child-friendly and exciting, like a picture in a children's book about rockets. Landscape 3:2 composition. The real SpaceX Starship vehicle, drawn accurately: a very tall slender two-stage rocket made of shiny stainless steel; the upper stage (the ship) has a pointed nose, a black heat-shield side and four flaps, two small at the top and two large at the bottom; the booster below it is a plain steel cylinder with four grid fins near its top; the launch tower is a tall dark steel lattice tower with two long horizontal catching arms. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, flags, symbols or wordmarks anywhere in the image, and no writing on the rocket, the tower, the trucks or the ground.

prompts.fact_biggest: The full Starship stack, ship on top of booster, standing upright on its launch pad and towering high above everything around it. Tiny trucks, a few tiny people and small palm trees at the foot of the rocket make its enormous size obvious. Low camera looking up so the rocket fills the height of the picture.
prompts.fact_catch: View from the front, looking at the tall dark lattice launch tower in the background centre. Two long horizontal catching arms are attached to the tower and reach straight out towards the viewer, side by side, spread wide apart like a pair of open tongs. Between the two arm tips, in the gap, the Super Heavy booster hovers upright in mid-air with no ship on top: a plain stainless-steel cylinder with a flat top and four grid fins, no black side, no nose cone, no flaps. Bright orange rocket flames pour from its engines at the bottom with a little smoke. Both arms are complete, solid and connected to the tower. Blue sky.
prompts.fact_engines: The bottom of the Super Heavy booster seen from directly below and slightly from the side, looking up at its flat base. The base shows exactly three concentric rings of rocket engines: 3 engines in the centre, a ring of 10 engines around them, and an outer ring of 20 engines, all clearly separated, all firing with bright orange and yellow flames streaming down towards the viewer. Steel body of the booster curving away above, blue sky behind.
prompts.fact_mechazilla: Side view of the very tall dark lattice launch tower, drawn big, with its two long horizontal arms (the chopsticks) attached to the tower and reaching out sideways to the right, one above the other, both complete, solid and connected to the tower, stretched wide open like giant robot arms. The shiny Starship rocket stands upright on its pad beside the tower, just beyond the tips of the arms. Camera slightly low, blue sky.
prompts.fact_starbase: A wide view of a launch site on a flat sandy coast: the Starship rocket standing on its pad with the dark lattice launch tower beside it, a few low white buildings and tanks, a sandy beach and the blue sea with gentle waves stretching to the horizon on one side, flat green-yellow grassland on the other. Warm sunny day.
prompts.fact_steel: A close-up of the shiny stainless-steel hull of the Starship, filling the whole picture: a smooth curved mirror-like steel wall made of stacked rings, with thin horizontal weld seams between the rings, reflecting the blue sky and white clouds. Bright sunlight and soft highlights on the polished metal.
